assertions.title: File uploads work for source bundles and WASM artifacts

steps.action: Upload a zip source bundle containing app.wasm through the Source Bundle Upload form.
steps.expected: The form shows Uploading..., then a success message with build details, and resets cleanly without surfacing an error.
steps.observed: The Source Bundle form showed Uploading... and then rendered 'Bundle accepted. Build bld_3fb2a3ec530f21bdabde63b5 is in pending.', but the same success state also surfaced the inline error 'Cannot read properties of null (reading 'reset')'.

steps.action: Upload a .wasm artifact through the Prebuilt WASM Artifact form.
steps.expected: The form shows Uploading..., then a success message with build details, and resets cleanly without surfacing an error.
steps.observed: The artifact form rendered 'Artifact ready: bld_059bfb1865ab88bba1ce203d (wasm/wasi-command / stdout-bridge)' and reset the Source Ref to upload, but it also displayed the inline error 'Cannot read properties of null (reading 'reset')'.

steps.action: Corroborate the resulting build records through the API.
steps.expected: Both upload forms create real built records.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7960 returned bld_3fb2a3ec530f21bdabde63b5 with buildStrategy prebuilt_wasm and status built, plus bld_059bfb1865ab88bba1ce203d with buildStrategy uploaded_artifact and status built.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed in the browser console; the failure was a user-visible inline form error shown after each successful upload
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7960 confirmed both upload builds were created and marked built despite the UI surfacing reset errors.

assertions.issues: Both upload flows created real builds, but the success state is incorrect because each form also surfaced an inline 'Cannot read properties of null (reading 'reset')' error after the upload completed.

assertions.title: Deployment creation and listing works

steps.action: Submit a deployment using the first built-only option shown in the form.
steps.expected: A built artifact should be deployable through the form, showing Deploying... and then a deployment result card.
steps.observed: The first built option bld_059bfb1865ab88bba1ce203d showed Deploying..., but the UI returned the inline error 'resource profile not ready yet' and no deployment record was created.

steps.action: Retry deployment using the alternate built artifact bld_3fb2a3ec530f21bdabde63b5.
steps.expected: The result card shows deployment ID, status, domain, reachable endpoint link, resource profile, and the deployments/domains lists refresh with log access.
steps.observed: The retry showed Deploying... and did create dep_9173a9c71ba57387021b2015 plus domain fh-panels-rerun-def2730f6e24u2r-0315-1.janus.run; the filtered Deployments panel refreshed and exposed a deployment View Logs button, but the deployment stayed starting and the reachable endpoint remained 'Not available yet'.

steps.action: Poll the deployment after creation through the UI/API.
steps.expected: The deployment reaches a usable runtime endpoint.
steps.observed: Repeated API polls over ~40 seconds kept dep_9173a9c71ba57387021b2015 in status starting and the matching domain record dom_d8538b16a058e53c7e54bace had runtimeEndpoint ''.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed while submitting the deployment form or opening the deployment log entry point
evidence.network: The first built option failed in the UI with 'resource profile not ready yet'. The retry persisted as GET /api/v1/deployments?projectId=proj_7960 -> dep_9173a9c71ba57387021b2015 (starting, build bld_3fb2a3ec530f21bdabde63b5); client-side filtering of GET /api/v1/domains showed dom_d8538b16a058e53c7e54bace with runtimeEndpoint empty.

assertions.issues: Deployment creation is incomplete: one built artifact cannot be deployed because the UI reports 'resource profile not ready yet', and the alternate built artifact never advanced past starting or exposed a reachable endpoint link.

assertions.issues: The modal's Copy control did not succeed in the real browser session because clipboard write permission was denied, even though filtering, auto-update toggle, download, and close all worked.

summary: Tested 8 assigned dashboard-panel rerun assertions: 5 passed (VAL-FH-014, VAL-FH-015, VAL-FH-017, VAL-FH-019, VAL-FH-022) and 3 failed (VAL-FH-016, VAL-FH-018, VAL-FH-020). Strongest evidence: proj_7960 was created and propagated across workflow selectors; repo import plus both upload paths created real build records, but uploads surfaced inline reset errors on success; deployment retry persisted dep_9173a9c71ba57387021b2015/dom_d8538b16a058e53c7e54bace yet stayed starting with no endpoint after ~40 seconds; and the log modal's Copy action still failed with clipboard write permission denied while Download succeeded.
